subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Nadir
solution:
The correct answer is: **Zenith**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nadir **means the lowest point or the bottom. (सबसे निचला बिंदु या तल)
 
• **Zenith **means the highest point or the top. (उच्चतम बिंदु या शिखर)
 
• The antonym of 'nadir' is 'zenith'.
 
 
• **Example**: After facing many failures
